# ledgerline

Ledgerline is the invoicing and billing servce for Acme. It creates invoices,
computes tax, posts finalized invoices to the external ledger, and exports
monthly reports.

## Layout

- `src/billing/` - money, invoices, refunds, and tax logic
- `src/api/` - the HTTP endpoints
- `migrations/` - the SQL schema migrations
- `scripts/` - operational scripts

## Development

Install the dependancies with `pip install -e .[dev]`, then run the tests.
[project]
name = "ledgerline"
version = "2026.9.1"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["flask>=3.0", "structlog>=24.1", "requests>=2.32"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]

The tests use pytest, with two Makefile targets:

```bash
pip install -e .[dev]   # one-time: installs pytest and the app's dependencies

make test-fast          # pytest -m "not postgres" -q  (skips tests marked postgres)
make test               # pytest -q                    (full suite, includes postgres tests)
```

`make test-fast` is the one to use day to day; a saved project note also names it as the usual command. It skips the tests marked `postgres`, so it should work without a database. Use `make test` when you need the full suite, which includes those Postgres tests, so you'll need a database available.

To run one file or one test, call pytest directly, e.g. `pytest tests/<file>.py -k <name> -q`.

I haven't run either target here, so I can't confirm the suite currently passes.
